notes: Speech memory hygiene + crash breadcrumbs (2026-09-04a) — Problem 2 'forced refresh' fix. Root cause (fleet census + code audit): every sentence gate created a fresh Recorder -> a live AudioContext + getUserMedia stream that was NEVER closed; iPadOS Safari enforces a hard live-context limit, and ~10+ leaked contexts per session killed the WebContent process ~5 min in (the white-screen 'forced refresh' — matches every kill diagnostic: speech moments, 290-338s page age). Fix: Recorder.stop() now closes its AudioContext and releases all graph references + raw PCM; speech_engine transcribe() eagerly disposes the pipeline output tensor and the 3x-repeat audio buffer. B1 breadcrumbs: speech state (spGate/spFails/spRec/spLastMs/spLib/spSrc/spCompileMs) merges into the kill-surviving csPageHeartbeat so the NEXT restart diagnostic reports exactly what the speech pipeline was doing at death. New regression suite test_speech_hygiene.js wired into npm test (10 tests). Data-loss note: server-side fixes (acks 2026-09-03a, lost-update race + PK-safe writes 2026-09-04) already deployed; Minnie's Sep-2 partial loss (exercises arrived, session + increment vanished) matches the race signature exactly and predates the fix.
